agent.finish_summary: Fixed IndexError: pop from empty list regression in sqlparse/engine/statement_splitter.py. The 'END' branch in _handle_closing_keyword had inverted logic (`if not (self._block_stack): self._block_stack.pop()`), causing a crash whenever a statement contained a bare END keyword (e.g., any CASE...END expression) with no block open on the stack. Fixed to `if self._block_stack: self._block_stack.pop()`, matching the pattern used by all sibling branches (END IF, END FOR, END WHILE, END LOOP, END CASE). Verified via manual testing that reindent/reindent_aligned formatting of CASE statements (including nested and BETWEEN variants) now works without error, deeply nested CASE expressions format quickly (well under 1s), and existing BEGIN...END block-closing behavior is preserved.
